5–15 min per trade (not counting collecting the items)

Several NPCs scattered around the world trade items dropped by monsters for useful {wiki:Quest Items|quest items}, such as the {item:Magic Sulphur}, the {item:Enchanted Chicken Wing} or the {item:Spider Silk Yarn}. This page gathers the most common trades: collect the requested items, go to the right NPC and make the trade.
You can obtain Quest Items by handing items dropped by monsters over to NPCs.
Level between 0 and 35 depending on the exchange (recommended 8–20).

Quest items used in other quests and addons (see tables below)
Bring all the items at once: the exchange happens as soon as the NPC confirms you have them.
With the NPC, say {key:hi} and ask for the item you want to receive (the English name). Confirm with {key:yes} when he asks whether you brought the items.
Trading weapons and armour for metals

Go to {npc:A Sweaty Cyclops}, near Ab'Dendriel, with the item you want to exchange. He is on the **4th floor** of a tower: in Ab'Dendriel, go down the hole in the wheat field **east** of the depot, cross the small {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms} cave and climb the tower. To leave, go down the tower, go back through the cave and use the {item:Rope} on the hole to climb up to the wheat field.
A Sweaty Cyclops (4th floor of the tower)

Talk to {npc:Haroun} or {npc:Yaman} with the items. {npc:Haroun} is in {wiki:Ashta'daramai} (blue djinn fortress): leave **Ankrahmun** to the **north** and follow the ramp into the mountains. {npc:Yaman} is in {wiki:Mal'ouquah} (green djinn fortress): follow the passage next to the Ankrahmun oasis into the mountains. Only players of **level 30+** can get through the fortress entrance doors. To leave, go back the same way to the ramp and go down to Ankrahmun.
Passage next to the oasis to Mal'ouquah (Yaman)
Trading clothes for pieces of cloth (Irmana)
Talk to {npc:Irmana}, in Venore's clothing warehouse.

Go to {wiki:Meriana} and talk to {npc:Marina}. {wiki:Meriana} is an island in the Shattered Isles, near Liberty Bay. In **Liberty Bay**, talk to {npc:Captain Waverider}: {key:hi}, {key:peg leg}, {key:yes} (50 gp; only works after the *Access to Meriana* mission of {wiki:The Shattered Isles Quest}). Marina is **north** of Sabrehaven. To return, {npc:Sebastian}, **south** of Sabrehaven, takes you to Liberty Bay ({key:hi}, {key:liberty bay}, {key:yes}, 50 gp).

The dangers depend on the exchange: for example {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms}; {creature:Scorpion|Scorpions}, {creature:Hyaena|Hyaenas}, {creature:Cobra|Cobras} and {creature:Nomad (Basic)|Nomads}; {creature:Tiger|Tigers} and {creature:Centipede|Centipedes} on the way to the NPCs.
